Usage Tips

Leave all seeds set to fixed (default in this workflow).
Never enable 60 FPS from the start (the 3rd section, 60 FPS, is always enabled by default).

If you like a video, enable 60 FPS afterward in the corresponding section (1st or 2nd) of the generated video.
Since the seed remains the same (high and low), the video will be regenerated directly in 60 FPS, saving time.

Second tip:
Do not enable the 2nd and 3rd sections from the beginning.
First, generate your initial video.
If you like it, keep the same seed and enable the 2nd section: the second video will be generated directly using the same base.
If you do not like the video, simply change the seed.

Additional tip:
If you want a cleaner workflow and do not want to see links, enable Hide Links at the bottom right in the Canvas menu.

Finally, if the workflow appears empty or no nodes are visible
(this can happen when opening subgraphs):
click Fit View in the Canvas menu.
If the Canvas is not visible, enable it here:
(Settings → Canvas → Lite Graph → Show Graph Canvas).

# Motion Settings

## Motion Amplitude
**Description:** Motion intensity multiplier  
**Default / Recommended:** 1.0 = normal, 1.15 = recommended  
**Range:** 1.0 – 2.0

## Motion Frames
**Description:** Number of trailing frames from `previous_video` used as motion reference  
**Default:** 5

# Video Resolution Settings

## FindPerfectResolution
**Description:** Adjusts the correct aspect ratio of the image for the video
